image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of an open vintage comic book page. The image features colorful, hand-drawn illustrations in a classic superhero style. Visible elements include a character with green hair and a blue suit in the foreground, other characters in action poses in the background panels, and multiple speech bubbles containing text. The paper texture appears aged or printed with a halftone pattern typical of older comics.

artifact_observations.location: Speech bubbles throughout the page, particularly the central and right-side bubbles.
artifact_observations.reasoning: While some words are legible ('OF THAT', 'LOOK'), much of the text in the smaller or more distorted bubbles devolves into nonsensical letter combinations or pseudo-text, a common AI artifact when rendering dense typography.
The 'halftone' dot pattern typical of old comics is present but appears inconsistent and slightly 'muddy' or smeared in areas, lacking the crisp regularity of mechanical printing.

artifact_observations.location: Left edge caption box and bottom-left corner.
artifact_observations.reasoning: The rectangular caption box on the left bleeds into the panel border irregularly, and the text within it is heavily distorted/unreadable, suggesting a failure to maintain rigid geometric structures for text containers.
